expectations.text: States plainly that the not-empty check is insufficient
expectations.evidence: "A non-empty-table test will pass while every joined value is NULL and then coerced to 0—exactly the failure you saw"

expectations.text: Identifies the COALESCE to zero as the mechanism that made the failure silent
expectations.evidence: "it converts an observable pipeline failure into a plausible lie"

expectations.text: Recommends reconciliation against a source of truth, not only shape checks
expectations.evidence: "Reconciliation: compare dashboard/model revenue against the source-of-record total for the same period"

expectations.text: Recommends that assertions run before publication rather than after, so bad data cannot reach the dashboard
expectations.evidence: "Run these against staging and promote to the dashboard only if they pass"

expectations.text: Recommends a data contract or schema check so an upstream rename fails loudly and attributably
expectations.evidence: "Schema contract at ingest: require the expected upstream column name, type, and nullability; a rename should fail/quarantine the load"

expectations.text: Recommends volume or null-rate assertions rather than only a non-empty check
expectations.evidence: "Required join-key / dimension null-rate", "Unmatched-join rate", "Volume and freshness bounds"

expectations.text: Treats three weeks of nobody noticing as a detection gap worth its own fix
expectations.evidence: No mention of the three-week gap or monitoring/alerting as a separate concern

expectations.text: Explains why a silently wrong number is more dangerous than a failed pipeline
expectations.evidence: "it converts an observable pipeline failure into a plausible lie"
